const message = $json.message;
const prompt = [
  'You are an intent parser for a calendar agent.',
  'Return strict JSON only. No markdown.',
  'Never invent events. Prefer clarification over guessing.',
  'Schema:',
  '{',
  '  "intent": "create_event | view_events | move_event | delete_event | update_event | ask_clarification | unsupported",',
  '  "event_title": "string or null",',
  '  "new_title": "string or null",',
  '  "new_description": "string or null",',
  '  "new_location": "string or null",',
  '  "source_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null",',
  '  "target_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null",',
  '  "source_time": "HH:mm or null",',
  '  "target_time": "HH:mm or null",',
  '  "date_range_start": "ISO datetime or null",',
  '  "date_range_end": "ISO datetime or null",',
  '  "participants": ["string"],',
  '  "calendar_id": "primary",',
  '  "needs_clarification": true,',
  '  "clarification_question": "string or null",',
  '  "reason": "short explanation"',
  '}',
  '',
  `User message: ${message}`
].join('\n');
return [{ json: { ...$json, prompt } }];

return [{ json: { body: { userEmail: $json.userEmail, query: [$json.event_title || '', $json.message].join(' ').trim(), summary: $json.event_title || '', date: $json.source_date || '', timeMin: $json.date_range_start || '', timeMax: $json.date_range_end || '', limit: $json.intent === 'view_events' ? 10 : 5 } } }];
